title: Transfusion Associated HCV in a Pediatric Population
brief_summary: To identify a large cohort of children transfused in the decade prior to second-generation anti-hepatitis C virus (HCV) donor screening (1982-1992). This will not only identify cases for the study of persistent infection and chronic hepatitis in children, but will allow for the determination of the annualized risk of transfusion-associated hepatitis (TAH) infection in children, data that are not currently available.
